answer: Here is one mechanism that works: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because ridge only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, delta is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any nadir approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
